title: Magnetite
body:
Description

Magnetite is one of the many ores that can be found around Finlay Island and The moon. Magnetite ore can only spawn in Lightslate nodes. The raw form of Magnetite takes on a purple color with a fluorescent glow in cubic shapes. Putting Magnetite through a Refinery increases its value to $600 per stud. The price will remain the same even if refined Magnetite is forged. Despite having a 1/1000 chance to spawn only at night, Magnetite is relatively common to find on the surface. Magnetite will persist into the day if it spawns at night and despawn later, similar to other ores.

The ore stands out due to its vibrant color and glow, which is lost after being refined, or forged

As with any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Magnetite to complete schematics. But is NOT recommended. Magnetite does not glow at all when used to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Refined Magnetite used to sell for $1,000 per stud before it was debuffed in the update on August 8, 2023, which revamped the map.
  • Magnetite can be found on the moon! This is most likely very rare due to the rarity of the ore itself, and the placement.Magnetite is the only ore in the game that decreases in value when forged. This is in reference to how in real life when magnets are heated to high temperatures, they lose their magnetic force, thereby devaluing their efficacy. In other words, only refine Magnetite, DON'T forge it.
  • Magnetite, Ore, Pyrite, Lithium, and Stone are the only square-like ores in the game.
  • In the Typical Developers Discord server, Magnetite has reputedly been "eaten" by various users.
    • This is possibly due to how Magnetite can resemble candy, regardless of which form it is in—ore, refined, or forged.
